name: Data.gridLevelForms_eq_map_iotaPlus
summary: The image is contained in the target (level invariance from `Data.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain`); its orthogonal complement in the target is zero because a form orthogonal to the image has a weighted lift chain orthogonal to itself (adjointness), and the lift chain is injective (`Data.exists_isTriangle`).

steps.claim: gridLevelForms(D, m) is finite-dimensional (`Space.finite_levelSpace`). The target is the sum of the image K₁ and its orthogonal complement in K₂ = gridLevelForms(D, 0) (`Submodule.sup_orthogonal_inf_of_hasOrthogonalProjection`), the image lying in K₂ by the level invariance of `Data.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain` (i = 1); it remains that the complement is zero: let z be a form of the target orthogonal to the image.
steps.lean:
_).map (D.iotaPlus 1 _ 0) := have : Module.Finite ℂ (D.gridLevelForms D.m) := (finite_levelSpace
    (isConjKernelPair_gridKernel (by simp) _).1 ⟨_, isOpen_principalLevel Fact.out⟩)
  (sup_orthogonal_inf_of_hasOrthogonalProjection
    (K₁ := (D.gridLevelForms _).map (D.iotaPlus 1 _ 0)) (K₂ := D.gridLevelForms 0)
    (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun _ _ ⟨k, h⟩ ↦
    (((D.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain _ 1 D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound 0).1 one_ne_zero).1 _ ⟨k,
    h.1⟩ ((Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff gridModulus_one_ideal _).1 h)).trans
    (by simp))).symm.trans (sup_of_le_left (bot_le.trans' fun z ⟨hz, hy⟩ ↦ by
    let y : triBase .. := ⟨conjForm (isConjKernelPair_gridKernel (by simp) true).2 z,
      mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.2 (by simp [mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.1 hy · ·])⟩; have ⟨L, H⟩ :=
      D.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain true 1 le_rfl y; rw [iotaPlus] at H; simp at H
    exact Subtype.ext (star_eq_zero.1
      congr($((exists_isTriangle ..).choose_spec.eq_zero_of_weightedChain _ 0 (by omega) y
      (inner_self_eq_zero.1 ((H (conjForm (isConjKernelPair_gridKernel (by simp) false).2 _)).trans
      (congr(integral _ $(mul_comm ..)).trans (inner_eq_zero_symm.1 (hz _ ⟨_,
      mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.2 fun k h g ↦ congrArg (star <| · g) ((L NeZero.out).2 ⟨k,
      h.1⟩ ((Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff gridModulus_one_ideal _).1 h)), rfl⟩)))))).1))))

steps.claim: Let y be the conjugate form of z, read in the triangle base (it has the level).

By `Data.iotaPlus_adjoint_weightedChain` (grid Z, i = m) the weighted lift chain U of y satisfies ∫ ι(m)(φ)·U = ∫ ι(0)(φ)·y for all φ; taking φ the conjugate of U, the left side is ‖U‖² and the right side vanishes because z is orthogonal to the image; so U = 0, and by the injectivity of the weighted chain of the triangle (`Data.exists_isTriangle`, `IsTriangle.eq_zero_of_weightedChain`) y = 0, hence z = 0.
steps.lean:
exact Subtype.ext (star_eq_zero.1
      congr($((exists_isTriangle ..).choose_spec.eq_zero_of_weightedChain _ 0 (by omega) y
      (inner_self_eq_zero.1 ((H (conjForm (isConjKernelPair_gridKernel (by simp) false).2 _)).trans
      (congr(integral _ $(mul_comm ..)).trans (inner_eq_zero_symm.1 (hz _ ⟨_,
      mem_levelSpace_formRep_iff.2 fun k h g ↦ congrArg (star <| · g) ((L NeZero.out).2 ⟨k,
      h.1⟩ ((Modulus.mem_principalLevel_iff gridModulus_one_ideal _).1 h)), rfl⟩)))))).1))))
